#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int Num;
    string Line;
    
    while (cin >> Num) {
        cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after number
        getline(cin, Line);
        
        const char* Text = Line.c_str();
        int i, maxVal = 0, wordCount = 0, wordLen = 0;
        
        for (i = 0; i < Num; i++) {
            if (Text[i] != '_' && Text[i] != '(' && Text[i] != ')') {
                wordLen++;
            } else if (Text[i] == '_') {
                if (wordLen > maxVal) {
                    maxVal = wordLen;
                }
                wordLen = 0;
            } else if (Text[i] == '(') {
                if (wordLen > maxVal) {
                    maxVal = wordLen;
                }
                wordLen = 0;
                
                i++;
                
                while (i < Num) {
                    if (Text[i] != '_' && Text[i] != '(' && Text[i] != ')') {
                        wordLen++;
                        i++;
                    } else if (Text[i] == '_') {
                        if (wordLen != 0) {
                            wordCount++;
                            wordLen = 0;
                        }
                        i++;
                        if (Text[i] == ')') {
                            break;
                        }
                    } else if (Text[i] == ')') {
                        if (wordLen != 0) {
                            wordCount++;
                            wordLen = 0;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (wordLen > maxVal) {
            maxVal = wordLen;
        }
        wordLen = 0;
        
        cout << maxVal << " " << wordCount << endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
